title: English Practice Quiz 0807
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 01: Two people give conflicting incident accounts. A supervisor should:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Gather facts impartially before deciding. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 02: Constructive feedback should focus on:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Specific behaviour and practical improvement. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 03: A good delegation decision considers:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Skills, workload and authority. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 04: When team members disagree, a leader should:
options: Encourage respectful discussion and clarify shared goals
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Encourage respectful discussion and clarify shared goals. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 05: Accountability means:
options: Taking responsibility for assigned actions and outcomes
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Taking responsibility for assigned actions and outcomes. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 06: A performance objective should be:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Clear and measurable where possible. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 07: A supervisor responding to a mistake should:
options: Assess impact and address causes fairly
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Assess impact and address causes fairly. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 08: A coaching conversation aims to:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Support learning and improve performance. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 09: When priorities change, a leader should:
options: Explain the change and update responsibilities
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Explain the change and update responsibilities. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Leadership and Conflict Resolution 10: A fair workplace decision should be based on:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Relevant evidence and consistent standards. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.
